observations.behavior: Removes conditional rendering of the Recordings tab from its original position before Metrics and Settings.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the default ordering and visibility of tabs in the Experiment View UI. This could affect user workflow by removing a potentially useful debugging or analysis tool unless it is re-added elsewhere.

observations.behavior: Adds back the Recordings tab conditionally after Variants and History, rather than at the start.
observations.posthog_connection: Re-establishes access to recordings but changes their placement within the navigation hierarchy. The behavior depends on an unknown feature flag state; if disabled, users lose this capability entirely without warning.

observations.behavior: Updates snapshot hashes for several experiment-related visual components.
observations.posthog_connection: These are cache-busting updates for frontend snapshots. They do not change application behavior, only refresh cached assets, likely due to unrelated CSS or minor DOM changes in other hunks.

observations.limitations: The chunk does not show what changed inside ExperimentReplayTab or why its position was moved. It also lacks tests or migration notes explaining whether removing it from the default tab list is intentional and complete. No backend or API changes accompany these UI edits.

review.limitations: The chunk does not show what changed inside ExperimentReplayTab or why its position was moved. It also lacks tests or migration notes explaining whether removing it from the default tab list is intentional and complete. No backend or API changes accompany these UI edits.
review.reason: This group consists of a reordering of existing tabs and a set of snapshot hash updates. The code removes and then conditionally restores one tab; no new capability, correctness fix, or systemic improvement is demonstrated. This fits tier 1: narrow, localized maintenance/behaviour correction without broader benefit.
review.posthog_relevance: Changes could affect how users navigate an active experiment's settings and recordings. If Recordings were previously always shown, this may hide them unless the feature flag is enabled, potentially reducing discoverability. However, the patch provides no evidence that this improves reliability, performance, or user outcomes.
review.uncertainty: High dependency on unknown feature-flag state and lack of accompanying documentation or test assertions. Could be benign cleanup or incomplete removal.
